title: Qwen3.8-27B KLDs
body: I have been lurking on reddit for like 6 years, and this is the first time posting, so apologies for the mistakes. I'm not a native English speaker, so sorry for the bad English too. I used LLM to translate / refine my post, including images. This is my attempt to compare the Qwen3.8-27B quants. Qwen is a coding and STEM model so I used codeparrot/github-code-clean, EleutherAI/proof-pile-2, allenai/peS2o, equal parts
